judgment.notes: N001 is instantiated with m=n, A=E and positive exponents a>n in S002 or b>0 in S003; hence its finite-measure dimension implication and nonnegativity apply. Compactness is used in the Euclidean metric from D001. Grid and power-limit conditions are n>0, L≥1, 0<h0≤1 and a-n>0; S004 has finite positive radius δ/2 and exponent s>0. No E/M application is present.

S001 obtains the bounding box. For n>0, S002 bounds the number and diameter of grid cubes, giving cost ≤C n^(a/2) h0^(a-n). Arbitrarily small admissible meshes make each fixed-scale infimum zero; their supremum is zero. N001 then gives D≤a for all a>n, including exclusion of D=∞, so D≤n. S003 uses nonemptiness in the singleton ambient space and zero-cost covers to get D=0. S004 supplies an admissible finite-cost cover for every s,δ>0. Thus boundedness, 0≤D≤n<∞, all scale-content bounds and the conditional singleton assertion follow.

All three direct premises are used. F001 precedes the choice of L; C depends only on L,n. F002 exports a conditional inequality independent of L,a,h0,δ0, and F003 combines the exhaustive natural-number cases without branch leakage. Positivity and branch assumptions are discharged; s and δ are universally quantified. S004 also recalls the already established boundedness in S001. No future fact, producer proof, extra hypothesis or escaped witness is used.
